Hold the senior means-tested exemption public presentation the week of August 10th at the senior center.
The assessing office resolved its PDF/Adobe software need directly with vendor staff, so the town does not need to purchase a license.
Tentatively set the board's next two meetings for September 9th and September 23rd.
Discuss increasing the veterans exemption further at a future meeting before deciding whether the board will sponsor it for the November special town meeting.
The assessor will research how a larger senior exemption amount could be redistributed across all tax bills via a tax shift instead of being funded through the overlay.

minutes.headline: Assessors reviewed a lakefront property revaluation plan and weighed raising the veterans' tax exemption.
minutes.summary: The Board of Assessors received a detailed update on a neighborhood-by-neighborhood review of waterfront and lake-adjacent property valuations, aimed at correcting mislabeled parcels while avoiding sudden value drops before recoding takes effect on future tax bills. The board also discussed the principal assessor search (two candidates in a second interview round), planned a senior means-tested exemption presentation for early August, and opened discussion on possibly raising the veterans exemption for a future town meeting article. No formal votes were taken; the meeting ended with informal agreement on next steps and September meeting dates.

what_happened.line: Assessors kept waterfront valuation factors largely unchanged rather than apply raw sales-derived adjustments, to avoid dropping assessed values.
Recoding of waterfront parcels' site index and land-use codes will wait until around August, after the next preliminary tax bills go out.
The board opened discussion on raising the veterans' tax exemption but put off deciding whether to sponsor an article for November town meeting.
A public presentation on the senior means-tested exemption was set for the week of August 10th at the senior center.
No formal votes were taken at this meeting.

why_it_matters: Waterfront and lake-adjacent property owners should expect any valuation recoding to show up on a future actual tax bill, not the next preliminary one.

A larger veterans or senior exemption, and how it would be funded -- through the overlay or spread across all tax bills -- affects what other taxpayers pick up, and may come before a future town meeting.
Seniors weighing the means-tested exemption have a presentation to attend in August before applying.
